name: Mk I Superlaser
description: The Mk I Superlaser was the first model of kyber crystal-powered superlaser developed by the Galactic Empire. It was the primary weapon of the first Death Star battle station. Components for the superlaser dish were constructed at the Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex.
